}}'''Jaalam Nishur''' was a young [[Arad Doman|Domani]] soldier sworn to [[Rodel Ituralde]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jaalam Nishur}}

== Appearance ==
He was tall.

== Activities ==
He goes with Ituralde when they meet with the [[Dragonsworn]] leaders under the [[White Ribbon]].

He goes with Ituralde into [[Tarabon]], where they begin to engage the [[Seanchan]] in guerrilla tactics in the hope that the larger Seanchan force will follow them into Arad Doman.

He dies during this campaign.
